name: Microgrid site active-power setpoint allocator
summary: Distributes the assigned site power target among resources with available control capacity.
description: Distributes the assigned site power target among resources with available control capacity. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Site target and resource limits” at the input and “Resource active-power targets” at the output. Allocation depends on resource capabilities and priorities.
